svg.aria-label: Git-Hospital/helmbulance: 2 merged, 1 in review. matrix: a version whose workloads were never checked does not count as healthy (merged); classify: a helm call stopped at our own deadline, or Helm 4 stopping on a progress deadline, is INCONCLUSIVE (merged); chart-upgrade: refuse --scenario chart-upgrade without --from-version, and say SKIPPED, not INCONCLUSIVE (in review)
